text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
'Ugh, booor-ing! I'm just a kid, 
so I don't get all this complicated
music!'

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
My, my... How rude of me! 
To bore such an adorable principessa 
would surely invite divine retribution!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Well then,
I shall deliver this melodÃ­a to you. 
A special arrangement of the Pre-Fie
opening!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: 'P-Purifai!? Waaah!'

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. 
This is... so to speak,
a simulation experiment of emotional
shifts. 
And a revenge match for Earth-san.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. 
When Earth was practicing the violin, 
a bunch of kids gathered around, but...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Even though I played with all my heart, 
the children didn't enjoy it. 
...They just weren't familiar with classical
music, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The sparkle fading from those vibrant
eyes, 
leaving only despair to take hold... 
I never want to witness such an elegy
again!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Right...
It's not a challenge only you face. 
Children are honest,
and that very honesty can turn cruel.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: When I was doing voluntary training tooâ

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(...Oh? Are the kids looking at me? 
Well then—time for the "lovable,
plucky sweetheart" act!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
'Huff, puff... 
How many runs does that make now...?'

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
'But I won't give up! 
Even if I keep losing,
I want to win this time!'

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Boy A
text_block_list.text: …………Huh? Big sis... you're not strong?

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Boy B
text_block_list.text:
You're way faster than us, though... 
Aren't you a hero?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(Shoot...
THAT'S what she was hoping for?!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
What was needed was... a simple,
powerful charm. 
We should have been the ones to reach out
to the children.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì. Failing to gift even a single smile
would be 
a disgrace to the name of an artista!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Come on,
it's pratica! Let's resume practice!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... "Prifight!
I wanna listen to it right away~!"

And so, our special training continued, 
and Sounds of Earth's day of revenge 
had finally arrived!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I'll be watching closely. 
My production and Ms. Earth's music... 
The synergyâand the chemical reaction
between them!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Thank you for gathering, my Angeli!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Now... let us turn that unfinished étude 
into a magnificent armonia!

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Waaah...! It's PreFighters! 
It's the PreFighters song~!

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Boy B
text_block_list.text:
It's so lively...
and the sound is so beauuutiful~!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Approachable, yet grazioso... 
This is the musica we have reached!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...The kids were leaning in so eagerly. 
The production was a huge success!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
The immense synergy produced by music... 
I might be able to apply this myself.
Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
'No, no, I'm quite alright'... 
—Now's our chance!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to dedicate to the two of you... 
The most passionate amore in all the
world—

Sounds of Earth suddenly appeared 
and began playing a romantic melody. 
It felt as though a grand story were about
to unfold—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
'Phew... I'm not used to this academy,
so I got lost. 
Come to think of it,
isn't there a cafe here?'

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
'...If you show me around,
maybe I could treat you to tea as
thanks... 
W-What do you think...?'

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... 
We prepare a transfer student scenario, 
and use the power of BGM to stir up
emotions...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Even children who don't mince words are
captivated by it. 
Music is an essential element 
for producing the next generation!

Having acquired a powerful weapon (?), 
Royce and Royce continued to refine 
her self-promotion even further.
